from pathlib import Path
import os
import tempfile

path = Path('config/config.go')
content = '''package config

import \"fmt\"

type Config struct {
\\tHost       string
\\tListenPort int
}

func DefaultConfig() *Config {
\\treturn &Config{
\\t\\tHost:       \"localhost\",
\\t\\tListenPort: 8080,
\\t}
}

func (c *Config) Addr() string {
\\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%s:%d\", c.Host, c.ListenPort)
}
'''
stat = path.stat()
with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile('w', dir=path.parent, delete=False) as temp:
    temp.write(content)
    temp.flush()
    os.fsync(temp.fileno())
    temp_path = Path(temp.name)
os.chmod(temp_path, stat.st_mode)
os.utime(temp_path, ns=(stat.st_atime_ns, max(stat.st_mtime_ns + 1, os.stat(temp_path).st_mtime_ns)))
os.replace(temp_path, path)
PY
cat config/config.go
git diff -- config/config.go"
